cag_yesno.note: d1-3B usable at threshold 0.5 as-is; LFM/Qwen rows are yes-biased and need per-model thresholds. Labels procedural (certain by construction); no human review.

capacity_ram_trunk_cache_c4096.note: Retention census newest-to-oldest; evicted revisits recompute safely with exact answers.

cpu_correctness.note: Within one process and matched slot geometry every answer field (probabilities, confidence, noul, score, legends) compared exactly at observable JSON precision, no tolerance.

gpu_warm_trunk_ms.note: Medians, d1-3B Q4_K_M, flag ON vs flag OFF (separate processes). Within-run repeats PASS-exact in both runs; cross-run max abs diff 0.00254, zero choice flips.

kvtree_batching.note: 50 branches x ~1k tokens x 5 leaves. Up to 512 questions per request scale linearly (~40 ms/question) with no accuracy loss.

vram_trunks_per_gpu.image_note: 512px ~= 290 tokens; 1920x1080 class states need bigger slots.

warm_vs_bypass.note: Decisions safe; do not use warm trunks where bitwise-identical floats are required.
